system.description:
Where an ordinary reader merely brushes the psychic residue clinging to an object, the Kiasyd consumes it. Handling an item, she drinks in the emotional traces steeped into it — and leaves it scoured clean, its history devoured for her alone.

This power works exactly like the Intermediate Auspex power The Spirit's Touch and uses the same rules: touch the object and expend a Mental Trait for a turn of concentration, and each use lets you ask a Narrator one question about the item's past, answered truthfully but as distorted images or impressions. Because you devour those traces as you read them, anyone who afterward tries to examine the same object with The Spirit's Touch or Aura Absorption must first win a Static Mental Challenge (retest Awareness) against your permanent Mental Traits to glean any impression at all. The power works only on objects or places, never on people.
